title: Plugin tier-1 trigger tests
description: Tests that verify a given prompt routes to the correct skill (or to none). The gh-aw plugin-trigger-tests workflow runs these on every PR; the structural validator enforces presence and shape.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor tooling (VS Code, etc.). Ignored at validation time.

tier.description: Tier-1 = trigger routing. Tier-2 (structural artefact assertions) and tier-3 (quality evals) are reserved for later schema versions.

tests.description: At minimum 3 cases. Recommend at least one positive per model-invocable skill, plus at least one anti-trigger.

prompt.description: The user prompt the router should route.

oneOf.description: Skill name (kebab-case) that should fire. Must reference a real skill in the same plugin.
Anti-trigger: no skill should fire for this prompt.

rationale.description: Why this test case exists. The LLM reviewer reads this to judge coverage.
